question: 65 human checkout sessions, 0 paid, 0 keys minted: broken funnel or healthy-funnel-zero-demand?
verdict: MIXED: the purchase path is mechanically sound end-to-end (verified live, everything short of entering a card); the 65-human numerator is measurement contamination, proven three independent ways; verified in-product human demand is zero in instrument v2. Zero paid is what a healthy funnel at zero verified demand produces. What is broken is instrumentation and cancel recovery, not checkout.

autonomously_fixable.what: Tag navigation-verified sessions: in billing/src/index.js /buy handler pass isHumanNavigation(request.headers) into createCheckout and write metadata[nav]='1'|'0'. kpi.mjs then counts human_sessions as probe absent AND nav='1'. Keeps the deliberate buyer-safety trade-off (accept-html requests still reach Stripe) while making the numerator honest.
KPI sample hygiene: exclude sessions with no metadata.product (shared Stripe account), and paginate or use a created-gte window so 'last 100' stops being a 10-hour burst window (has_more true today).

cancel_url per product: createCheckout sends cancel_url https://<host>/s/<productId> so a cancel re-lands on the pitch with its Buy button, instead of the home page. Update the pin in billing/test/checkout.test.mjs:141.
Tag the tenant-fixture probes: the validation path that mints anon_0000000... tenant sessions must send x-mcp-probe: 1 so they stop landing in the human count.
files: scripts/validate.mjs or the probe caller (hosted/orchestrator-owned: handoff)
